S44.01.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.01.note: The aria-label of the + button was not found in the code, so it is described by position only.
steps: Open a chat and click the + button beside the message box, then click Create image.
Type a prompt into the message box.
Press the send button.
Look for the Generating image card, then check that an image replaces it in the conversation, as Expected says.
S44.01.where: Chat > message box: the + button > Create image; then type a prompt and press the send button

S44.02.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.02.note: The list only offers models the account's deployment marks as enabled; the picker is not shown until the media models have loaded.
steps: Click the + button beside the message box, then click Create image.
Click the button with the current model name (aria-label Select image model).
Pick a different model from the list.
Send a prompt and compare the caption Generated with <model> on the result with Expected.
S44.02.where: Chat > message box: Create image mode on, then the button labelled Select image model (shows the model name) > pick a model

S44.03.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.03.note: A preset does not set a separate style option; it appends its phrase to the prompt text.
steps: Turn on Create image from the + button.
Click the button labelled Style (aria-label Add a style to the prompt).
Click a preset such as Photorealistic in the Image style menu.
Check the message box: the preset words were added to the prompt, then send and compare the look with Expected.
S44.03.where: Chat > message box (Create image on) > Style > Image style menu > pick a preset such as Photorealistic

S44.04.needs: a file to upload (up to several images)
S44.04.note: No separate visible reference slots were found; reference images are the extra attachments after the first, per the code at ChatComposerNew.tsx around line 3777.
steps: Turn on Create image from the + button.
Click + and choose Add photos & files, then attach images.
Check that the first attached image is treated as the one to edit and the others as references (the code shows the notice Attach up to ... images: the first is edited and the others guide it.).
Send and compare the result with Expected.
S44.04.where: Chat > message box (Create image on) > + button > Add photos & files

S44.07.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.07.note: The ratio list comes from the selected model's options, so some ratios may be missing for some models.
steps: Turn on Create image from the + button.
Click the button with the aspect ratio text (aria-label Select aspect ratio).
Pick a ratio from the list.
Send and check the picked ratio on the generated image.
S44.07.where: Chat > message box (Create image on) > button labelled Auto (aria-label Select aspect ratio) > pick a ratio

labels.text: Return the image on a transparent background

S44.11.needs: an account with image generation enabled and a model that supports editing
S44.11.note: The button only appears when the chosen image model supports editing.
steps: Turn on Create image and choose a model that supports editing.
Click the button labelled Transparent (tooltip: Return the image on a transparent background).
Check that the button shows as on, then send a prompt.
Compare the background of the result with Expected.
S44.11.where: Chat > message box (Create image on) > Transparent button

labels.text: Image generation stopped before a result was received.

S44.18.needs: an account with image generation enabled and time to press stop before the image finishes
S44.18.note: The generating card itself has no stop button; the stop path is the composer button, which calls the image cancel logic in WebChatPage.tsx. The code path for a media placeholder shows Stop generating in MediaGenerationPlaceholder.tsx, and it was not confirmed whether images use it.
steps: Start an image from Create image with a prompt and send it.
While the Generating image card shows, click the stop button (tooltip Stop generation).
Look for the card Image generation stopped before a result was received.
Compare with Expected: the job is cancelled and not billed further (billing cannot be seen on screen).
S44.18.where: Chat > message box: Stop generation (the send button turns into this while an image is generating)

labels.text: Image generation stopped before a result was received.

S44.19.needs: an account with image generation enabled and a stopped or failed image
S44.19.note: When a rate limit applies the button text becomes Try again shortly or Try again in Ns, and the button is not clickable until it is over.
steps: Stop an image generation as in S44.18, or use one that failed.
Click the Try again button on the card.
Check that a new Generating image card appears with the same prompt.
Compare with Expected.
S44.19.where: Chat > the image card after a stop or failure > Try again

S44.20.needs: an account with image generation enabled and a model that supports editing
S44.20.note: Variation is disabled unless the model supports editing, and the tooltip says why.
steps: Open a generated image in chat and click Revise this image.
Click the Variation button in the panel.
Look for a new image of the same prompt in the same card, with the earlier versions still reachable through the Previous version and Next version buttons.
Compare with Expected.
S44.20.where: Chat > generated image > Revise this image (pencil button) > Variation

steps: Click Library in the sidebar.
Look at the grid of saved items and click the Images filter if shown.
Use the Grid view button to confirm the grid mode.
Compare the saved images with Expected.
S44.21.where: Sidebar: Library > Library page (grid view is the default); filter Images

S44.22.note: The exact click that opens the viewer was not confirmed in the code; the dialog and its zoom buttons were found at LibraryView.tsx around lines 1202 to 1243.
steps: Open Library from the sidebar.
Click an image in the grid.
Check the full-screen viewer opens, and use Zoom in and Zoom out.
Compare with Expected.
S44.22.where: Library > click an image to open its viewer (dialog named <name> viewer)

S44.23.note: The card shows the model and ratio; no visible size or quality text was found in the card, and the full prompt display was not confirmed (the card title is the prompt cut to 40 characters).
steps: Look at the caption under a generated image in chat.
Check that it shows the model name and the ratio when not Auto.
Compare with Expected (prompt, ratio, size, quality).
S44.23.where: Chat > generated image card: the caption Generated with <model> · <ratio>

S44.24.needs: a saved generated image in the Library
S44.24.note: The name of the item menu trigger was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Open Library and open the menu of a generated image.
Click Remix.
Check the message box now holds the image's prompt and the image is attached.
Compare with Expected.
S44.24.where: Library > item menu > Remix (the prompt is loaded into the message box)

S44.25.needs: a saved generated image in the Library
S44.25.note: No separate Reuse settings control was found; it is the same Remix action.
steps: Open Library and open the menu of a generated image.
Click Remix.
Check the model and the ratio shown in the composer match the original image.
Compare with Expected.
S44.25.where: Library > item menu > Remix (the same action also sets the model and ratio)

S44.27.needs: an account with image generation enabled
steps: Click More actions on a generated image card.
Click Save to Library.
Look for the toast Saved to your Library. It stays after this chat is gone.
Open Library from the sidebar and check the image is there.
S44.27.where: Chat > generated image > More actions > Save to Library

S44.28.needs: a Project and a generated image in the Library
S44.28.note: The menu item appears only when the file type is accepted for projects, and the item menu trigger name was not confirmed.
steps: Open Library and open the menu of a generated image.
Click Add to project.
Choose a project in the dialog titled Add to project.
Open that project and check the image is listed.
S44.28.where: Library > item menu > Add to project > dialog Add to project

S44.29.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.29.note: The Download control in the share sheet (aria-label Download image) also exists; full quality was not verified in code.
steps: Click More actions on a generated image card.
Click Download.
Open the file that downloads and check its size and sharpness.
Compare with Expected.
S44.29.where: Chat > generated image > More actions > Download

S44.30.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.30.note: The image-copy function body was not read; the link-copy in the share sheet is a separate control labelled Copy link.
steps: Click Copy on a generated image.
Look for the Copied text on the button.
Paste into another app and check that the image itself is pasted, as Expected says.
Compare with Expected.
S44.30.where: Chat > generated image > Copy (tooltip and label Copy image)

S44.33.needs: an account with image generation enabled and a model that supports editing
S44.33.note: Without editing support the panel only regenerates from the text; the code path for editing the source pixels was not run.
steps: Click Revise this image on a generated image.
Type the change in the box and press the send control.
For a masked edit, click Select area, then Mask image, and paint the area.
Compare the result with the source image and Expected.
S44.33.where: Chat > generated image > Revise this image (pencil button) > describe the change and send

labels.text: Reported. Thank you: our trust and safety team will review it.

S44.35.needs: an account with image generation enabled
S44.35.note: The report item sits in the assistant message menu; that the image card messages show it was not confirmed, and the menu trigger name was not found.
steps: Open the menu of a generated image's assistant message.
Click Report this response.
Look for the text Reporting… then Reported, and the toast Reported. Thank you: our trust and safety team will review it.
Compare with Expected.
S44.35.where: Chat > assistant message > message menu > Report this response

S44.36.note: No visible text saying AI-generated was found in ImageGenerationCard.tsx; the only visible attribution is the Generated with caption. Provenance is in the file route's response headers (route.ts:250).
S44.36.where: Machine-readable provenance is sent with the file response (apps/web/app/api/files/[id]/route.ts), not a visible control
